title: South Fergus Secondary Plan presented to committee
subtitle: Procedure By-law amendments, including consent agenda and delegate limits, were reviewed; a closed session on labour relations produced no public items.
overview: The Committee of the Whole heard a presentation on the South Fergus Secondary Plan, which sets out the mix and density of land use, the collector road network, the size and location of parks and school sites, and major services. Staff and the planning consultant said the plan is put into effect later through zoning by-law amendments, plans of subdivision and site plan applications. The committee received the planning report for information {{vote:m1}}. One councillor declared a conflict of interest and left the room for this item.

The committee also received a report on proposed amendments to the Procedure By-law 2021-31 for information {{vote:m2}}. Proposed changes include hybrid meeting participation, a consent agenda, a revised order of business, a shorter time limit for delegates and limits on how often they can appear, and a changed meeting curfew. One councillor raised concerns about holding two Council meetings a month.

The committee met in closed session on a labour relations matter {{vote:m3}}. The Mayor reported no items to bring forward from that session. Neither report was a final decision, so residents can expect both to return for further consideration.

decisions.detail: The committee received Report PLN2024-14 on the South Fergus Secondary Plan for information {{vote:m1}}.
The committee received Report COR2024-14 on proposed amendments to Procedure By-law 2021-31 for information {{vote:m2}}.
